hypothesis: The accepted v79 blockout can preserve useful identity and proportion evidence through MetaHuman conform without being mistaken for production topology or rigging.
action: Seal the clean head input, fixed Go captures, measurements and production gates as the first immutable comparison baseline.
expectedResult: Future MetaHuman candidates can be compared against reproducible v001 evidence while unverified AAA components remain unscored.
actualResult: v001 now contains verified input lineage, fixed captures, identity/body measurements and fail-closed gates, but no production MetaHuman candidate or comparable parent scores.
rationale: This is the first pipeline iteration and therefore establishes evidence rather than claiming improvement.
